title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 3: Akira Yuki
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．３ 「結城 晶」
overview:
Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series is a series of eleven Sega Saturn discs released in Japan between October 1995 and March 1996, each containing images of one Virtua Fighter character.

This disc features Akira Yuki, born September 23, 1968. Akira is a 25-year-old kung-fu teacher with blood type O. Akira is largely considered the main protagonist of Virtua Fighter, featuring predominantly on the games' cover art.
